notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an item to replace the Amnesia Flask, due to it being useless now: Midas Drink.
[*] Fixed the icon for Leech Juice.
[*] Fixed a sound effect issue in chapter 6, that was continuing when it shouldn't have.
[*] Changed the social media buttons on the title screen.
[*] Fixed the prologue selection in the chapter select menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=g5L6gcSVQtk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]NEW[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added two new scenes around the end of chapter 2, instead of using popup dialogue windows.
[*] Completely remade the maps at the end of chapter 3.
[*] Completely remade the prologue ( New maps and dialogues ).
[*] Added, modified and improved dialogues in chapter 1 through 3.
[*] Changed where a new game starts, in media res.
[*] Added a new tutorial window, briefly explaining the basics during the first fights of the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37384046/bdd5dc8c90bb0bf28c36e0c7f07d7f85903a6d16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37384046/a0093eace6ceaeaa5f4acb659da9bd802365ccd4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37384046/e1af107554a2dab1e683703aecc3320495ff4506.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37384046/52344ded4495999a1611cbbb828560130cc8d2d5.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a dialogue popup as a hint to the last puzzle of the castle in chapter 7, upon failing 3 times.
[*] Balanced the stats of Hannah's enemy data.
[*] Slightly improved the maps in chapter 1 through 3.
[*] Changed the controls manager.
[*] Changed the distance, or speed, for diagonal movements on keyboard.
[*] Lowered Karlene Morgan's boss battle movement speed.
[*] Increased Marth's TP gains.
[*] Changed the number of difficulties to 3.
[*] Lowered the volume of the dialogue beep sound.
[*] Changed the HP of tier 1 and flying tier enemies.
[*] Buffed Elyzio's tutorial enemy HP.
[*] Buffed the Reaper's mini boss HP.
[*] Reduced the damage of chapter 1's boss fight.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37384046/e0117e201aaf13fdeef83f87d75b7bc5d997cb96.gif[/img]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed tilemap Qpopup crash that would happen when oppening a menu while getting shot by loads of projectiles all at once.
[*] Fixed analog stick movement.
[*] Fixed some tutorial instructions that were obsolete due to newer updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.75
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased the duration of buffs to 20 seconds.
[*] Fixed an animation bug for the WitchDoctor.
[*] Fixed the black borders issue when scaling the game to full screen on certain monitors.
[*] Fixed a checkpoint bug in Deron Forest.
[*] The player's move speed out of combat is now the same as in combat.
[*] Fixed a major oversight with the bridge puzzle of chapter 6 where the player would be stuck with the wrong character.
[*] Removed the Skill Points system.
[*] Reduced all TP costs to 30.
[*] Reduced all MP costs to 10.
[*] Removed quick items.
[*] Remade and improved all the damage formulas. 
[*] Removed the damage value from skill info because of an issue with the new formulas.
[*] Rebalanced all skills.
[*] Fixed a bug where Marth would be standing up instead of being collapsed in chapter 6.
[*] Lowered stats of the doppelganger enemy.
[*] Balanced the healing of the final boss.
[*] Slightly smoother camera.
[*] Increased base damage for all player skills.
[*] Adjusted the amount of MP ethers recover due to the modification of max MP in a previous patch.
[*] All characters can be played at any moment upon reloading any save file after completing the game.
[*] Fixed a Party Chat popup that wouldn't disapear.
[*] Fixed a TP overlay bug with Elyzio.
[*] Remapped the transform button to "Select" on controllers. 
[*] Added a prompt to leave the Wytherion puzzle in chapter 6.
[*] Fixed analog radian movement for controllers.
[*] Reduced HP and defense of Witchdoctors.
[*] Fixed an enemy move speed bug upon dying by a dash attack.
[*] Remade the first puzzle of the castle in chapter 7.
[*] Changed required TP to trigger the transformations to 100 for every character.
[*] Added an overlay picture for the transform trigger when the TP gauge is full.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5.15
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Hannah's TP during her arena boss fight is now infinite, for the sake of the story and difficulty
[*] Fixed a bug with Hannah'a Taunt skill during her arena boss fight
[*] More detaIls concerning the "TP Modes" are given upon unlocking the first "TP Mode"
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Removed the "LiquidIron" item for it was rendered irrelevant due to the 1.5 update
[*]Added the "LeechJuice" item as a replacement for the "LiquidIron", which heals the
player for 3% of the damage dealt while the buff is active
[*]The "MegaElixir" item now grants the "Leech" buff instead of "IronBlood"
[*]Fixed a bug with the new dashing mechanics
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed "Jump Away"s on player hit
[*] Fixed the freezing bug upon getting hit by a lot of attacks at once
[*] Reduced the mana scaling rate
[*] Balanced Elyzun's HP
[*] Changed enemy stats scaling
[*] Reduced poison damage rate
[*] Reduced the regeneration rate of final boss of the Arena of Masters
[*] Reduced the speed of PyroSaber II
[*] Changed joystick mode to D-Pad to maximize compatibility
[*] Improved dashing mechanics
[*] SwiftStab now hits all enemies
[*] DashAttack II now has a longer delay
[*] Difficulty setting multiplier affects enemy damage instead of enemy levels
[*] Reduced time of debuffs
[*] Increased time of Holy Waters
[*] Changed the contrast of the bubbles in the Volcano for more visibility
[*] Fixed a bug that would freeze the game upon dying from poison after winning a battle
[*] Fixed Skill Points HUD showing during the credits
[*] Fixed horse not dismounting itself upon entering the abandonned house
[*] Added a popup for the regeneration of the final boss of the Arena of Masters
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed the ghosts in one of the hammer puzzles in chapter VII.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs in the puzzles of chapter VII.
[*] The enemies now keep their skill cooldowns upon the use of a phoenix tear, instead of resetting.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 2 more seconds to the 2nd blue ghosts puzzle in the castle.
[*] Blue ghosts are now more visible.
[*] The poison state is now shown in the HUD.
[*] The 'Town Teleport' NPC now has a special icon on the compass.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*] There is now an overlay on the TP gauge when it's full.
[*] Infoboxes can now be closed with the mouse.
[*] The puzzle stone in the elven forest now has a close-up view.
[*] The climbing stones are now lighter and easier to see.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The options menu can now be accessed with the 'Esc' button.
[*]An option to delete all save data has been added to the options menu.
[*]An option to view the controls has been added to the options menu.
[*]Removed the 'StunSpark' skill from Elyzun.
[*]Elyzun's ThunderWield skill deals less damage.
[*]Elyzun's SwiftStab skill deals less damage.
[*]The Executionner's attack stat has been lowered.
[*]The SwarmBlast skill deals less damage.
[*]The EnergyTornado skill deals less damage.
[*]Removed 'slow' debuff for the player.
[*]Reduced the damage of the 'poisoned' state.
[*]Changed the font for tutorial messages.
[*]Added current exp and next level exp values to the exp bar.
[*]Added a ghost shopkeeper before certain fights where a shop wasn't available.
[/list]
